_comment: ComicInfo v2.0 schema definition for CBZ Editor. Add custom fields here.

fields.label: Title
fields.tooltip: The title of this individual issue.

fields.label: Series
fields.tooltip: The name of the series this issue belongs to.

fields.label: Issue #
fields.tooltip: The issue number within the series (e.g. 1, 2, 10.5).

fields.label: Count
fields.tooltip: Total number of issues in the series. Use -1 if unknown.

fields.label: Volume
fields.tooltip: The volume number. Whole integer only (e.g. 1, 2, 3).

fields.label: Alternate Series
fields.tooltip: An alternate series name this issue also belongs to.

fields.label: Alternate Number
fields.tooltip: The issue number within the alternate series.

fields.label: Alternate Count
fields.tooltip: Total issues in the alternate series.

fields.label: Summary
fields.tooltip: A description or plot summary of this issue.

fields.label: Notes
fields.tooltip: Free-form notes, typically used for scan or release info.

fields.label: Publication Date
fields.tooltip: Publication date. Type a full date, a year alone, or 'MM/yyyy' for year and month — a full date can also be picked from the calendar button. Combines the underlying Year/Month/Day fields into one.

fields.label: Month
fields.tooltip: Publication month as a number, 1–12.

fields.label: Day
fields.tooltip: Publication day of the month, 1–31.

fields.label: Writer
fields.tooltip: Writer(s). Separate multiple names with a comma.

fields.label: Penciller
fields.tooltip: Penciller(s). Separate multiple names with a comma.

fields.label: Inker
fields.tooltip: Inker(s). Separate multiple names with a comma.

fields.label: Colorist
fields.tooltip: Colorist(s). Separate multiple names with a comma.

fields.label: Letterer
fields.tooltip: Letterer(s). Separate multiple names with a comma.

fields.label: Cover Artist
fields.tooltip: Cover artist(s). Separate multiple names with a comma.

fields.label: Editor
fields.tooltip: Editor(s). Separate multiple names with a comma.

fields.label: Publisher
fields.tooltip: The publisher of this comic (e.g. Marvel, DC, Image).

fields.label: Imprint
fields.tooltip: Publisher imprint or sub-label (e.g. Vertigo, MAX).

fields.label: Genre
fields.tooltip: Genre(s) for this issue (e.g. Superhero, Horror, Sci-Fi).

fields.label: Web
fields.tooltip: A URL relating to this issue (e.g. publisher page).

fields.label: Page Count
fields.tooltip: Total number of pages in this issue. Auto-detect reads from the zip.

fields.label: Language (ISO)
fields.tooltip: ISO 639-1 language code for the issue language (e.g. en, fr, de).

fields.label: Format
fields.tooltip: Publication format (e.g. TPB, HC, Annual, Digital).

fields.label: Black & White
fields.tooltip: Whether this issue is in black and white.

fields.label: Manga
fields.tooltip: Whether this is a manga title, and its reading direction.

fields.label: Age Rating
fields.tooltip: The age/content rating for this issue.

fields.label: Characters
fields.tooltip: Featured characters. Separate multiple names with a comma.

fields.label: Teams
fields.tooltip: Featured teams or groups. Separate with a comma.

fields.label: Locations
fields.tooltip: Key locations in this issue. Separate with a comma.

fields.label: Story Arc
fields.tooltip: The story arc or event this issue is part of.

fields.label: Series Group
fields.tooltip: A grouping label for related series.

fields.label: Scan Information
fields.tooltip: Information about the scan source or scanning group.

fields.label: Main Character/Team
fields.tooltip: The primary character or team this series follows.

fields.label: Community Rating
fields.tooltip: Community star rating, 0.0–5.0 (decimal allowed).

fields.label: Review
fields.tooltip: A review or editorial comment about this issue.

int_hints.Count: total number of issues in the series (e.g. 6, 12)
int_hints.AlternateCount: total issues in the alternate series (e.g. 4)
